headline: TPOLY, EMC, TRITN and PF stand out on unusual trading, while SOLAR and SCC have notable filings requiring review.
market_take: Trading was uneven across the 232-stock coverage universe, with sharp moves concentrated in PROP, CONS, AGRI and CONMAT. Unusual-trading alerts were elevated, including gaps and volume spikes, while SOLAR and SCC were the main names with substantive recent filings. PF and VPO combine notable price weakness with unusual trading, whereas TPOLY advanced alongside an intraday alert.

sector_notes.note: TPOLY rose +16.67% with volume×2.98 and an intraday-move alert; EMC also recorded a -50.00% open gap and +100.00% intraday move, while TRITN had a +50.00% open gap followed by a -33.33% intraday move.

KC rose +100.00% on volume×0.01 and A gained +29.91% on volume×0.11, while PF fell -33.33% with volume×1.12 and a -33.33% open gap. SENA fell -9.72% on volume×7.77, the highest volume ratio among the top movers.
VPO fell -13.51% with volume×1.3 and had both a -5.41% open gap and an -8.57% intraday move; TRUBB also declined -4.49%.

PPP fell -6.67% with volume×3.06 and a -5.00% open gap. SCC disclosed an information memorandum on the combination of its Olefins and Polyolefins businesses, with a financial advisor opinion also filed.
MIPF rose +6.17% but on volume×0.16; unusual-trading volume alerts included AMATAR at 5.6σ, SPRIME at 4.9σ, B-WORK at 3.6σ and CPNCG at 3.5σ versus 20D averages.
CFRESH rose +4.55% with volume×2.06. XBIO recorded a +33.33% open gap and -25.00% intraday move, while SUN had a 7.5σ volume spike and NRF a -5.00% open gap.
